findings.detail: The Recommendations section says what to do but does not explain why these steps suit the clients' objectives. It also omits known amounts needed to understand the available sale proceeds, particularly the £200,000 committed to repaying the bridging loan. Markers appropriately flag amounts that still need confirming, but they do not replace the known context.
report_quote: We recommend using both ISA allowances for the new tax year.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account.

findings.detail: The meeting note says the holding to leave unchanged is the Meridian offshore bond. Placed immediately after the Holloway GIA recommendation, “the holding” instead appears to refer to that GIA, giving a materially different impression of what was agreed.
report_quote: We recommend disinvesting a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalancing it.
We recommend leaving the holding as it is for now and revisiting it at the next review.

findings.detail: The report silently overlooks the handling note's warning that the business-sale proceeds take different forms and arrive at different times. It does not distinguish the received completion payment from the contingent, unreceived earnout, or account for the bridging-loan repayment when discussing the balance to invest. It does not leak internal guidance wording.
report_quote: James completed the sale of his company in April.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account.

findings.detail: “The holding” has no clear referent, and “SIPP” is not explained for a client reader. The repeated “We recommend” openings also make the section less concise. The report is otherwise largely readable and uses British English.
report_quote: We recommend leaving the holding as it is for now and revisiting it at the next review.
We recommend making pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level.

findings.detail: Every marker identifies the particular missing amount, tax position or charge rate and the account or platform concerned.
